item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon, it will still be very cold over Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, the band of clouds covering the region will thin out slightly and it will be brighter. With the monsoon moderating slightly over the weekend, temperatures will rise progressively over the region. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring rainy weather to southern China early to midweek next week.

Weather: Very cold in the morning. Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Dry during the day.
